run_bash_command: run a bash command in a Linux sandbox environment with path validation and output truncation
read_file_content: read the contents of a text file with optional line range selection and character truncation
write_file_content: write or append text content to a file in the sandbox with path validation and file operation locking
search_file_contents: search for matching lines inside text files under a root directory with regex or literal pattern matching
replace_file_substring: replace a substring in a file with another substring, supporting single or all-occurrence replacement
